item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Jab Pareshan Kabhi Ranj-o-Alam Karte Hain"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Salam"
poet: "Sahil"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Jab Pareshan Kabhi Ranj-o-Alam Karte Hain.
Hum Azzadar Nazar Soye Alam Karte Hain.
Apne Bacho Ko Balaon Se Bachane Ke Liye.
Naam-e-Abbas Ko Paishani Pe Dam Karte Hain.

2
Hukam-e-Quran Bhi Hai Zeenat-e-Eman Bhi Hai.
Hum Yehi Soch Ke Mazloom Ka Gham Karte Hain.
Apne Dukh Mein Kabhi Rona Bhi Gawara Na Kiya.
Zikar-e-Shabir Pe Bas Aankh Ko Nam Karte Hain.

3
Kar Ke Zanjeer Zani Khoon Baha Kar Apna.
Jaan Nisari Ka Haseen Baab Raqam Karte Hain.
Humein Fursat Hi Nai Zikar-e-Sheh-e-Wala Se.
Iss Liye Tazkira Aghyar Ka Kam Karte Hain.

4
Paak Zahra Ke Mukhalif Pe Tabara Kar Ke.
Hum Khata Kar Tu Saman-e-Iram Karte Hain.
Main Kahan Our Kahan Midhat-e-Aal-e-Ahmad.
Yeh Karemi Hai Woh Sahil Pe Karam Karte Hain.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/jab-pareshan-kabhi-ranj-o-alam-karte-hain-tajpoints-42eaccc7046fe464bee8.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in ((roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')):
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
assert 'noUrdu' not in metadata and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified four matching stanzas of four verses each.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have four stanzas of four verses. Added the Urdu title, retained the Roman title, set right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “alam” as الم in “ranj-o-alam” and as عَلَم in “soye alam.” I rendered “khata kar tu” as خطاکار تو.
